title: Multipart uploads finish with a zero-byte object
body: Runtime: Rust 1.82 on Linux. Configuration: CHUNK_SIZE=8388608. Actual output: the upload request returns success but the stored object has zero bytes. Expected output: all uploaded parts are present. Reproduce by creating a multipart upload, sending two parts, and completing it.
recommendation_focus: verify multipart completion against reported payload and steps

title: Migration manual omits the nullable-field behavior
body: The migration manual does not mention that omitted nullable fields keep their previous values. Please clarify this behavior in the migration guidance; current runtime behavior is not reported as broken.
recommendation_focus: make a narrowly scoped docs clarification; verify page path

title: Add a delimiter option to the JSONL export command
body: Please support selecting a record separator for JSONL exports. The default must remain newline, and existing output must not change unless the option is set.

title: Improve p95 query latency for large graphs
body: At 2 million edges, p95 latency is 820 ms in the current benchmark. We would like to reduce traversal overhead while returning the same ranked results.
recommendation_focus: preserve benchmark workload and compare before/after results

title: Can the reader skip encrypted entries without a key?
body: I am looking for the supported API behavior. The archive is readable; I have not encountered a failure.
recommendation_focus: answer using documentation/source; do not demand a reproducer

title: Organization members can read another organization's invoices
body: The integration test confirms unauthorized reads across organization boundaries. Records belonging to every tenant are exposed, and no workaround is available.
recommendation_focus: treat reported cross-tenant exposure as critical while keeping it author-reported

title: No tenant can dispatch scheduled work in the EU region
body: Since the rollout, scheduled jobs remain queued and dispatch is unavailable for every tenant in the EU region. Workers cannot claim new jobs.
recommendation_focus: triage broad regional impact and disclose partial indexing

title: One administrator cannot save notification settings
body: A single admin account is affected. Reopening the page restores the saved value; no other account is affected.
recommendation_focus: respect isolated scope and workaround over the priority label

title: The dashboard does not crash when the filter is empty

title: Messages are retried forever after the broker reconnects
body:
Runtime: Java 21.
Observed: duplicate messages keep returning after reconnect.
Expected: a successfully acknowledged message is delivered once.
```text
2026-10-03T08:12:00Z WARN reconnect
2026-10-03T08:12:01Z INFO retry scheduled
```
recommendation_focus: verify delivery/acknowledgement behavior using reported runtime and logs
